content.value: The boom is intended to support two vertical load, $\overrightarrow { F _ { 1 } }$ and $\overrightarrow { F _ { 2 } } .$ If the cable CB can sustain a (18) maximum load of 1800 N before it fails, determine the critical loads if $F _ { 1 } { = } 3 F _ { 3 }$ .
